title: AAPS Random restart since upgrade to V2.7
body:
hi,
Since upgrade to AAPS 2.7, the app restarts on its own a few times a day ramdomly.  
It happens whether i'm using an other app on phone Or NOT
In same environement, i had no issues with 2.6.1 AAPS version. 

System environment:
phone: Xiaomi MI9T
Android version: 10 / MIUI 12.0.2
Pump: Dana RS (fimrware V1) 
CGM: FSL+MIAO1
[AndroidAPS._2020-11-06_18-30-37_.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/5541444/AndroidAPS._2020-11-06_18-30-37_.log)

in log file, first iteration happens on line 8408. 


--------------

comments.body:
sorry the reason is not visible in log files.
Lot of small fixes are included in dev. You may test it
